# A Smith's First Bar

*Gareth the smith will show you the forge's first lesson: strike 4 copper ore from the veins in the fields, then smelt it into a copper ingot (open the Professions window and make it).*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Gareth](../npcs/gareth.md) |
| Level | 3 |
| After | [Shells for the Mayor](../quests/shells_for_the_mayor.md) |

## Objectives

1. Gather 4 [Copper Ore](../items/copper_ore.md)
2. Make 1 [Copper Ingot](../items/copper_ingot.md)

## Rewards

- 120 EXP
- 200 mesos
- Recipe: [Bronze Axe](../items/bronze_axe.md) ([Smithing](../professions/smithing.md))
- +20 standing with Kaldemor
